modelShade._example: jump:10% & snaps:9 = 4 lighter, 4 darker, with 10% jump steps in between.

surfaceShade._note: Manual surface shade for Background + Build Plate when auto brightness is OFF.
surfaceShade._example: Uses same stop behavior as modelShade, but for surface sliders.

shadeResponse._note: Asymmetric manual response. 1.0 = full strength, <1 softens, >1 boosts.
shadeResponse._example: lightenScale=0.5 means only 50% of lightening intensity vs base manual curve.

autoBrightness._formula: Auto applies the same surfaceShade curve at the configured auto shade value.
autoBrightness._note: Auto mode now matches manual shade response (same -100/+100 appearance for the same base color).

background._example: shade=-100 matches manual shade slider at -100 for the same synced/base color.

buildPlate._example: Same behavior as background; keep shade values aligned for parity.

presetShadeDefaults._note: Default manual shade loaded when selecting a preset (primarily when auto brightness is OFF).

model._example: Preset id -> default model tone. Example: ink=100 starts darker.

partInteractionModes._note: Visual emphasis rules for Inspect and Multi-Select modes. Keys must match exact state names used by the runtime (see getPartInteractionVisualProfile in script.js). Values are percentages: 100 = full/unchanged, lower = faded/desaturated.

inspect._states: base = all non-hovered parts; hovered = the single part under the cursor

base._note: Non-hovered parts remain unchanged in Inspect mode

hovered._note: The part currently under cursor: full emphasis

select._states: base = unselected & unhovered; selected = checked but not hovered; hoveredUnselected = cursor over unselected; hoveredSelected = cursor over selected

base._note: Default dim state for parts that are neither selected nor hovered

selected._note: Checked (selected) parts that are not currently hovered

hoveredUnselected._note: Cursor is over this part but it is not yet selected

hoveredSelected._note: Cursor is over this part and it is already selected
